item.description: The Design class is missing a lookup_domain method that tests expect. Multiple tests fail with AttributeError: 'Design' object has no attribute 'lookup_domain'
item.contract: Add a lookup_domain method to the Design class that can resolve domain names within the design hierarchy, returning the appropriate ClockDomain object based on the fragment context and domain name.

item.description: Multiple simulator tests fail because testbench functions are missing the required 'ctx' parameter. All tests in SimulatorRegressionTestCase fail with TypeError: <testbench function> missing 1 required positional argument: 'ctx'
item.contract: Update simulator testbench functions to accept and properly use the ctx parameter. The simulator should provide a context object that allows accessing and setting signal values in testbench functions.

item.description: Memory backend tests fail with "end." errors indicating issues with memory handling or test setup in the RTLIL backend
item.contract: Investigate and fix the RTLIL backend memory handling issues causing "end." errors in test_sync_read and test_async_read tests
